mapper.insert: INSERT INTO destination_translation_sources (destination_translation_id, wikidata_qid, source_title, source_url, source_revision_id, source_language, source_variant, license_name, license_url, attribution_text, original_content_sha256, content_modified, source_checked_at) VALUES (#{destinationTranslationId}, #{wikidataQid}, #{sourceTitle}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceRevisionId}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{sourceVariant}, #{licenseName}, #{licenseUrl}, #{attributionText}, #{originalContentSha256}, #{contentModified}, #{sourceCheckedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT destination_translation_id AS destinationTranslationId, wikidata_qid AS wikidataQid, source_title AS sourceTitle, source_url AS sourceUrl, source_revision_id AS sourceRevisionId, source_language AS sourceLanguage, source_variant AS sourceVariant, license_name AS licenseName, license_url AS licenseUrl, attribution_text AS attributionText, original_content_sha256 AS originalContentSha256, content_modified AS contentModified, source_checked_at AS sourceCheckedAt FROM destination_translation_sources WHERE destination_translation_id = #{translationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE destination_translation_sources SET content_modified = #{contentModified} WHERE destination_translation_id = #{translationId}
